column1: # License files of the components statically linked into the AppImage type2-runtime binaries (runtimes/runtime-*),
# fetched by bundle-and-compress.sh at pinned tags and verified by SHA256.
#   libfuse 3.15.0  scripts/common/install-dependencies.sh downloads fuse-3.15.0.tar.xz (lib/ is LGPL-2.1; the runtime
#                   Alpine 3.21 packages (scripts/docker/Dockerfile: FROM alpine:3.21, apk add ... musl-dev zstd-static
#                   zlib-static mimalloc-dev); the runtime strings say zstd 1.5.6 and zlib "inflate 1.3.1"
# The license notice embedded in the runtime binary lists runtime, musl, libfuse, squashfuse, libzstd and zlib (not mimalloc).
# Re-pin together with APPIMAGE_TYPE2_RELEASE (build.sh / download-runtime.sh): re-check the versions above, update
# the URLs and SHA256s (curl -fsSL <url> | sha256sum) and the release line. The build fails while they differ.

# source: - type2-runtime {APPIMAGE_TYPE2_RELEASE}: unmodified release binaries from https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/releases/tag/{APPIMAGE_TYPE2_RELEASE} (SHA256s and signing key in runtimes/VERSION.txt); source: https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/tree/{APPIMAGE_TYPE2_RELEASE}

# source: - libfuse 3.15.0, statically linked into the runtime (LGPL-2.1): https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/download/fuse-3.15.0/fuse-3.15.0.tar.xz, **modified** by type2-runtime's patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff (https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/blob/{APPIMAGE_TYPE2_RELEASE}/patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff); the runtime's complete source and build scripts are at the type2-runtime tag above
# source: - squashfuse 0.5.2, statically linked into the runtime: https://github.com/vasi/squashfuse/archive/0.5.2.tar.gz
# source: - musl 1.2.5, zstd 1.5.6, zlib 1.3.1 and mimalloc 2.1.7, statically linked into the runtime: Alpine Linux 3.21 packages (https://pkgs.alpinelinux.org/packages?branch=v3.21)
